text: Three real presentations, in three real formats: a live Power BI session for Executives, the published Tableau Public deck for the Board, and the reconciled workbook handed directly to Finance for their own sign-off.

What gets said about Chapter 7's discrepancy differs by audience, without either version being dishonest. Finance gets the full, specific story. Executives and the Board get an accurate, shorter version: a discrepancy was found and corrected before this meeting, and all three numbers now agree.
That's the real judgment call — giving each audience the right level of detail, the same way Lesson 18 made a judgment call about formatting, now applied to what gets said out loud.
This is what the architecture actually bought the business: a real error, caught and fixed before it ever reached the Board. Next lesson wraps up everything this capstone built, end to end.
